_comment: Model weight integrity manifest — AI600-007 / SA-12 / SR-3 / SI-7
_instructions: This file maps HuggingFace model IDs to SHA-256 digests of their anchor files.
Anchor files are small deterministic files that ship with every HuggingFace
To update this file after downloading a new model snapshot:
import hashlib, json; from pathlib import Path
def sha256(p): h=hashlib.sha256(); [h.update(c) for c in iter(lambda: open(p,'rb').read(65536), b'')]; return h.hexdigest()
base = Path('/path/to/downloaded/model')  # replace with actual path
print(json.dumps({f: sha256(base/f) for f in anchors if (base/f).exists()}, indent=2))
IMPORTANT: These hashes must be reviewed by a security engineer and committed
via a signed commit before being used in production deployments.
See docs/MODEL_CARD_REVIEW.md for license and security review status.
